execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Product" (
  "business_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "category_id" int4,
  "cost" numeric(10,2),
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."batch_supply_usage" (
  "batch_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "qty_used" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "supply_lot_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("batch_id", "supply_lot_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."batches" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "made_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "qty_made" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bill_of_materials" (
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "qty_required" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "supply_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "supply_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."businesses" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."categories" (
  "business_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."external_order_items" (
  "external_line_item_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "order_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "product_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "unit_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."external_orders" (
  "business_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "external_order_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "last_synced_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "ordered_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "sales_channel_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product_mappings" (
  "[product_id]" int4 NOT NULL,
  "external_sku_or_product_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "sales_channel_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sales_channel" (
  "access_token" text,
  "business_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "display_name" text NOT NULL,
  "external_shop_id" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "last_synced_at" timestamptz,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."supplies" (
  "business_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."supply_lots" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "purchased_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "qty_purchased" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "qty_remaining" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "supply_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "total_cost" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "business_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'owner' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
